summary: Iter30 — Task A (auto-flip linked HA Sale → 'paid' on invoice payment) + Task B (ISO 27001 / DPDP Policy Pack) end-to-end testing. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter30_extras.py with 6 new tests covering: (1) regular invoice without from_sale_no still 200 (no linked_sale_no leak), (2) all 7 policies render fully substituted (no '{{' remaining) with valid PDFs (>1KB, %PDF- magic), (3) auth-required (401/403 unauthenticated), (4) 404 on unknown policy, (5) raw template gating (super_admin/clinic_owner allowed, front_desk forbidden), (6) trade-in flow end-to-end on auto-flip (ha_trade_ins.status='applied' + old serial RETIRED). Frontend Playwright run on /settings/compliance as admin@delhi.test verified compliance-page testid, all 7 policy buttons (data-testid=policy-{id}), 'Personalised for: Delhi Test Branch · DPO: Delhi Admin · Effective: 2026-05-06' banner, click navigation to 04_incident_response updates pane in-place, Download PDF button hits /api/legal/policies/{id}/pdf returning 200 application/pdf, and nav-compliance is highlighted active on /settings/compliance. Confirmed nav-compliance is HIDDEN from front_desk role. Full backend regression: 15/15 PASS (9 reference + 6 new).
critical_code_review_comments: OK — mark_sale_paid_internal idempotency guard (status=='paid' → returns {already: True}) verified; 2nd payment on a paid invoice does not 5xx (test_autoflip_via_payment).
OK — initial_payment branch in billing.create_invoice fully covers the cash-in-hand happy path; sale + serial flip atomically (test_autoflip_with_initial_payment).

OK — trade-in finalisation: ha_trade_ins.status transitions accepted→applied AND serial_items[old].state→RETIRED only when sale.trade_in_id was passed via SaleCreate. The HTTPException catch in mark_sale_paid_internal (lines 462-465) correctly tolerates already-RETIRED serials (manual admin path) but still flips the trade-in row.

OK — legal/policies endpoints: list (count=7, dpdp_aligned=true), render (no '{{' leftovers), pdf (application/pdf, >1KB, %PDF- magic), 404 unknown, auth-gated, raw template clinic_owner/super_admin only — front_desk receives 401/403.

Minor (not a bug) — GET /api/legal/policies/{id}/raw returns the field as `markdown_raw` (with `policy_id` + `placeholders` siblings), while GET /api/legal/policies/{id} returns it as `markdown` (with `title`, `code`, `context`). Frontend reader uses the rendered endpoint so this is fine — but the inconsistency could trip up future API consumers; consider standardising on `markdown` everywhere with a `raw: bool` flag in the response.

Minor (UX) — 'View PDF' button on CompliancePolicyPack.jsx opens the PDF in a new tab via the same /pdf endpoint that requires Bearer auth — confirmed working since axios attaches the cookie/token, but a hardlink without auth would 401. Not blocking.
OK — AppShell nav gating: Compliance Pack hidden from front_desk (verified by login + DOM check); shown + active-highlighted for super_admin/clinic_owner.
